Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this match. We look forward to your company on Sunday for the game between Ireland and New Zealand at Malahide, Dublin. Let's hope there will be no rain. Do join us at 1045 local (0945 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!

The first outing for Bangladesh in these conditions wasn't a great one. Their batting struggled and it needed the partnership between Tamim Iqbal and Mahmudullah to bail them out. Ireland will be immensely pleased with their efforts in the field and Peter Chase's bowling was a big positive for them. Although, they would like to cut down on the extras as they bowled too many wides.
CALLED OFF! Unfortunate end to this encounter. The umpires did wait for the conditions to improve but the persistent drizzle meant, no more play.

Update 1556 local - The rain has reduced to a drizzle but still it's a persistent one. The covers remain where they were. The groundsmen will need the drizzle to stop completely to start their mopping work. The umpires came out a few minutes back but didn't look too impressed with the conditions. The cut-off time we are hearing for a 20-over game is 1810 local. We are fast approaching that time. Let's keep our fingers crossed. Stay tuned...

Update 1425 local - No respite from the rain. It continues to come down hard and the covers are firmly on. We have started to lose overs from hereon. Let's hope for the best. Stay tuned for latest updates...
Oh dear, it has started to rain and the covers are coming on. The players are rushing off the field. Let's hope it stops soon. Stay tuned, we will keep you posted.
Good length ball and it is stroked through covers for a run by Mahmudullah.
Drinks break.
A little flatter there by Dockrell and it is pushed to covers. Dot ball.
Paddle sweep by Mahmudullah to short fine leg and they get through for a run.
Flighted on leg stump. Tamim again uses his wrists and flicks it for a single towards deep square leg.
Full ball on off stump. Mahmudullah drives it through the covers for a run.
Full flighted delivery on leg stump, Tamim flicks it off his pads to deep square leg for a run.
Floats it on off stump. Tamim drives it back to the bowler.
An overpitched delivery outside off, driven crisply off the front foot but straight to the short extra cover fielder.
Angles in a good length ball on middle, Mahmudullah stands back to play it on the leg side but fails to middle it. Ends up pushing it back.
On a length around off, Mahmudullah stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Fullish and angling in from around off, Mahmudullah lunges and defends it back.
Sliced away! Full again, around off, Tamim tries playing straight but it flies off the outer half of the bat and goes safely to sweeper cover for a run.
Fullish and around off, Tamim plays an on drive but finds the fielder inside the circle.
Tim Murtagh is back into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fires a fuller one on the pads, Tamim clips it through mid-wicket for one.
The line is too straight on this occasion, it's flicked in front of square leg for a single.
Slower through the air outside off, dabbed straight to short third man. Three dot balls.
Quicker through the air this time, flatter and on middle, defended to the off side.
Nicely tossed up ball on middle, punched back to the bowler.
Full and on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Nearly repeats the last shot. But this time there ain't much pace to work with and he ends up hitting it straight to the third man fielder. A single taken.
FOUR! Easily done! McCarthy switches to around the wicket and delivers a short ball outside off, Tamim gets back and just uses the pace of the bowler to run it fine towards third man for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, pushed through covers for another single.
Full in length and outside off, driven through the gap at covers for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Turns it off his pads to backward square leg and the short fine leg fielder makes the stop.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Dockrell gives it some extra flight but lands it very full outside off, Mahmudullah unfurls a beautifully timed cover drive for a boundary. A shot of pedigree. No chance for the fielder in the deep. This partnership has certainly put Bangladesh back in the game.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
A flatter arm ball on middle, punched straight to mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, knocked down to long on for one.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
35th ODI fifty for Tamim Iqbal!

FOUR! Fine shot to reach his half century! Full and angling into the batsman, Iqbal gets on the front foot and pushes it back off the inside half of the bat. Still the timing is great and it speeds down to the fence down the ground. A responsible knock by Tamim, so far.
Shortish on middle, tapped down to mid-wicket for one.
Overdoes his line and bowls it too straight, Tamim flicks it behind square leg and takes a run.
FOUR! Useful boundary! A juicy half-volley outside off, Tamim leans into the drive and thumps it through the gap at covers for a boundary. Lovely timing and placement.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Sliding down the leg side, bowled from around the wicket, Tamim eased it to fine leg for one.
Barry McCarthy is back on.
Flatter and shorter on off, another late cut shot towards short third man for a run.
Flighted on off, defended back to the bowler.
Loopy around off, Tamim plays a cute paddle sweep but finds short fine leg.
Floated full ball on off, Tamim is on the front foot in defense.
Leans forward to flick but gets a little leading edge towards the cover region.
Shortish and on off, Tamim plays it very late, almost off the keeper's gloves and guides it past short third man. Chase chases it down and they take a couple of runs.
A touch short and wide outside off, Mahmudullah flashes and misses.
50-run partnership between Mahmudullah and Tamim Iqbal!
On the pads, tucked to deep backward square leg for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. No run.
Short in length on off, Mahmudullah pulls it off his front foot, a wristy one, more like a tennis forehand and it races through mid-wicket. The ball stops before the rope and they take three runs.
Full and angling into the batsman, Tamim gets forward and pushes it to covers for a quick single. Smart running between the wickets!
Thompson runs in from around the wicket and angles in a length ball around off, Tamim stays back and taps it down to backward point.
Flatter and on off, defended from the crease to cover-point. Looked for a run but was then sent back. Just a wide from the over.
Floated full ball on off, Mahmudullah prods and defends it to the off side.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, an easy leave for Mahmudullah.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flicks it off his pads but finds the fielder on the leg side.
Loopy and outside off, extra bounce, Mahmudullah gets across the stumps and blocks it to the off side.
Short outside off, slapped to point where the fielder made a good jumping stop.
Wide! Way down the leg side, Tamim leaves it.
Short and wide, cut through point for a single.
FOUR! Thompson serves another freebie, a full toss on the pads, this time Mahmudullah doesn't miss out and whips it through square leg for a boundary.
Porterfield saves a certain boundary. A loose delivery, full toss wide outside off, Mahmudullah chases and hits it towards point where a fantastic stop has been made.
Fails to flick and it goes off his pads to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
A slip comes in.

Shout for an lbw! Full in length and just around off, Tamim lunges with his bat and pad together in defense. It hit the latter and they appeal. Nothing from the umpire, maybe the impact was outside off.
Flighted and outside off, Mahmudullah tries to tap and run but the point fielder quickly gets to the ball stops him in his tracks.
Probably an arm ball skidding down, Mahmudullah tries keeping it out but is hit on the pads.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
SIX! Just over Kevin! Tossed up ball around off, Mahmudullah dances down the track and powers it over mid on. Kevin O'Brien in the deep tries his best to catch it over his head but it sails past him.
Flighted ball on off, going straight on, Mahmudullah tries to defend but it beats the inside edge and goes past the keeper. They run a couple of times. Given as runs. Maybe some inside edge.
First look of a spinner! George Dockrell is into the attack.
Short and outside off, Mahmudullah dabs it to third man for a run.

Appeal for an lbw! Thompson angles in a length from around off, Mahmudullah fails to flick and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire remains still. Maybe, missing leg and it seemed too high as well.
Angling down the leg side, a touch short, Tamim glances it to long leg for one.
Targets the off stump with a full length delivery, Tamim gets behind the line and defends it back.
Beaten! Pitches it full outside off, nipping away, Tamim is lured into the drive and gets beaten.
Wide! Too many extras conceded by Ireland. Short and down the leg side, left alone.
Full and straight, it's driven in front of point for a run.
Fuller and on off, flicked behind square leg for a single.
Leans forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Kevin is struggling with his line. Slips it down the leg side, Iqbal fails to get any wood behind it.
Pitches it full and around off, Tamim lunges and defends it back.
Straying on the pads, Mahmudullah fails to flick and collects a leg bye as the ball travels to deep backward square leg.
A touch short and around middle, Tamim turns and drops it with soft hands to mid-wicket for a run.
Short delivery around leg, Tamim gets on top of the bounce and pulls it behind square leg for a couple.
Full and angling in around off, Mahmudullah defends it off his back foot to the off side.
Drizzle is back.
Way wide outside off, just inside the tramline, Mahmudullah leaves it alone.
Fullish on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Shortish and outside off, cut straight to point.
FOUR! Thompson offers width outside off, Mahmudullah latches onto it and whacks it square of the wicket on the off side. Finds the gap behind point and fetches a boundary.
Stuart Thompson is into the attack now.
Beaten! Skiddy delivery, full and wide outside off, Mahmudullah tries to drive but is beaten.
A rising delivery, around off, Tamim is on his toes as he keeps it out.
Plenty of movement behind the bowler's arm there. Tamim pulls out as Kevin was into his delivery stride.
Short and wide outside off, forced off the back foot to sweeper cover for one.
Presses forward and across to a full ball around off and works it to mid-wicket.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Mahmudullah tries flicking but misses.
Width on offer outside off, on the shorter side, Tamim flays at it and sends it behind point for a single.
Stays back footed and guides it down to third man for a single.
Two wides! Loosener first up, way down the leg side, Iqbal leaves it and the keeper fumbles while collecting. They cross.
Kevin O'Brien is introduced into the attack. He is on 97 ODI wickets.
Straighter in line, clipped through square leg for a run.
Extra bounce around off, Tamim tries to play on the leg side but is beaten. Takes a blow near the tummy area.
Outside off, tapped down to point.
Wide! The right-left combination putting the bowler's line off. He bowls it down the leg side to the left-hander, Tamim leaves it.
Shortish outside off, guided to third man for a run.

LUCKY FOUR! McCarthy bowls it on a length outside off, Mahmudullah pokes inside the line and gets a thick outside edge. It runs wide of second slip and reaches the boundary. Third man was pretty square on this occasion.
Good length ball on middle, turned to mid-wicket for a run.
Barry McCarthy runs in but pulls out at the last moment. It seems he lost his run-up. Reload.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah drops his wrists and allows it through.
Mahmudullah joins Tamim Iqbal in the middle. Big responsibility on this pair.

Drinks break. Ireland have got the best possible start to this game. Their pacers exploited the conditions to their advantage and exposed the vulnerable visiting batsmen. Tamim Iqbal is fighting the lone battle and needs someone to stay with him out there.
OUT! Gone, Chase comes round the wicket, bowls it on length just outside off. Shakib defends it and gets an edge and the keeper Neil Obrein takes a good low catch.
FOUR! Short on the body of the batsman. Shakib pulls it very fine, past the diving keeper for another boundary. That's two in two for Shakib.
FOUR! Short just outside off stump, Shakib guides it beautifully between third man and point and it races away to the fence. Pure timing by Shakib.
A little away movement for chase, Shakib goes to flick it and gets a leading edge and goes on the bounce to cover.
Tight bowling from Chase, Shakib defends the ball of the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sliding down the leg side, nudged behind square leg for one.
Full and wide outside off, Shakib goes chasing after it and mistimes his drive to covers.
Short and angling away from the batsman, outside off, Shakib pulls it from the crease but finds the mid-wicket fielder inside the ring.
Fuller and in the line of the stumps, defended back to the bowler.
Angles in a length ball on off, Tamim gets back and helps it to mid-wicket for one.
Short delivery and pulls it to square leg for a couple of runs.
Short outside off and is cut to deep point. Thompson the fielder in the deep makes a fine stop diving to his right. They pick up a single.
Driven on the up by Shakib and it was brilliantly stopped by Murtagh at mid off. Saved a certain boundary, only a run taken.
It's bowled on a length and Tamim opens the face to guide it to third man for a single.
Short outside off this time, Shakib guides it to third man for a single.
Short of a length, Tamim nudges it to square leg for a single.
Wide! Chase starts off with a wide down the leg side. Tamim leaves it.
Peter Chase being brought back for his second spell.
Fuller and on off, defended back to the bowler.
A good looking cover drive by Shakib but he fails to find the gap.
Gets across the stumps and defends it to the leg side.
Wide! McCarthy slips it down the leg side from around the wicket, Shakib fails to flick.
Short and outside off, Tamim slaps it off his back foot, waits for the point fielder to make his dive and once the ball goes past him, they cross for a single.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, called a wide.
Wide! Bowls it down the leg side, Tamim goes to flick it but misses it and is signaled wide.
Bowls it on his pads and Shakib nudges it down to fine leg for a single. He gets off the mark.

The superstar of the Bangladesh team, Shakib Al Hasan arrives at number 5. His team is in a spot of bother and the stand-in skipper for this match would like to lead from the front. In case you don't know, Mashrafe Mortaza is serving a one-match ban because of the slow-over rate in his last ODI appearance.

OUT! Gone, Rahim edges this one to first slip. McCarthy bowls it a little outside off, gets a bit of away shape and Rahim goes for an expansive drive on the up. He however gets an outside edge and it is taken sharply by Gary Wilson. It's a big blow for Bangladesh as they lose an experienced batsman.
A gentle fuller length ball on off, Tamim lunges and defends it to the off side.
Bowls it on a fuller length and in the line of the stumps, Iqbal covers the line and blocks it safely.
Tamim has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This time Murtagh takes it away off the seam, Iqbal feels for it and gets beaten.
Beats the inside edge! Lovely inswinger, landing around off, Tamim strides to defend but it curves back in to beat him.
Now maximum four fielders will be allowed outside the circle. Bangladesh will look to find the gaps and keep the scoreboard ticking without taking any risk.
EDGY FOUR! Murtagh gets a length ball to nip away after landing outside off, Tamim stretches forward to defend but gets a big fat outside edge past first slip for a boundary.
Powerplay 2 taken.
The batsman has played it to the point region. No run to end the over. Good comeback by the bowler after conceding a couple of boundaries first up.
Terrific yorker, right in the blockhole, Rahim does well to dig it out.
Back of a length ball on off, defended off the back foot to point.
Better delivery, full and outside off, shaping away, Rahim shoulders arms.
FOUR! Replica of the last delivery. Barry once again tries his luck with the short delivery outside off, Rahim shows no qualms in whacking it through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Lovely shot! A gentle loosener first up, McCarthy drags his length short and bowls it outside off, Rahim stands back and slams it past the point fielder for a boundary.
Barry McCarthy replaces Chase in the attack.
Full again, but Tamim does not time it and it's driven to mid off.
FOUR! Through the covers this time. Full outside off and Tamim drives it to the covers, beating the diving fielder inside the ring for a boundary. Lovely shot.
FOUR! Full ball on off stump, Tamim drives it beautifully down the ground, beats mid off and it races to the fence for a boundary.
Short of a length delivery, Tamim stands tall and pushes it to covers of the back foot.
Length ball outside off and Tamim covers the line and defends it.
Bowled on a length, and was defended off the front foot by Tamim.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single. End of a testing over by Peter!
Great delivery, bowls it full and just outside off, forcing the batsman to play at it. Tamim tries to drive but the ball straightens a touch to beat the outside edge.
Stifled appeal for an lbw! An inswinger on this occasion, Tamim tries working it on the leg side but fails to middle it. They appeal but it appears to be doing too much.
Beautifully bowled. An outswinger landing outside off, Tamim keeps his bat near his front pad and lets it through.
Chase switches to around the wicket and serves a length ball just around off, it skids through after landing, Tamim plays inside the line and misses.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full and going down the leg side, Tamim just picks it off his pads and eases it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Wide! Short and wide outside off, Tamim goes chasing after it but fails to connect. Wild attempt!
Good length delivery. The batsman defends it by getting right behind the line.
Down the leg side again. He flicks it away for a single. Given as a leg bye.
Full and wide, Tamim goes after it but misses it completely.
Good length and he plays it off the front foot into the ground.
Again on a good length, Tamim comes forward and defends it with a straight bat.
Good length delivery and it is defended off the front foot by Tamim.
A big appeal, but the batsman is struck high on the pads and the appeal is turned down by the umpire. Good length ball, jags back in and hits Rahim high on the pads. Good bowling here from Chase.
Wide ball, way down the leg side. An attempted short ball but it's way down the leg side and signaled a wide.
Good length delivery, Rahim misses it and is hit on the pads. They appeal for it but the umpire shakes his head.
Once again bowled on the pads of Tamim, he nudges it down to fine leg for a single.
Bowls at a good length, outside off and Tamim decides to leave it alone.
FOUR! Full ball on pads of Tamim. He stylishly flicks it to deep backward square leg, Murtagh dives to stop it in the deep but misses and the ball goes for a boundary.
Good length delivery by Chase. Bowls it outside off and Tamim decides to leave it.

Shout for an lbw, a muted one though. Excellent seam movement this time, landing around off and nipping in sharply, Rahim fails to keep it out and is hit high on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Deftly played! Murtagh loses his radar and slips a length ball down the leg side, Rahim picks it off his pads and neatly deflects it down to fine leg for a boundary.
On a length and in the channel outside off, Rahim has an easy leave on this occasion.
Full and angling into the batsman around off, shaping away a shade, Rahim gets forward with a minimum footwork and pushes it a bit uppishly towards cover-point.
Bowls it on a driving length outside off, Rahim covers the line and then shoulders arms.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. End of another impressive over by Peter Chase.
Prods forward to a full ball outside off and drives it to covers.
Straighter in line, Tamim plays it off his pads to the leg side, finds the fielder.
Greets the new batsman with a shortish ball outside, Rahim steers it wide of backward point for a single.

Mushfiqur Rahim is in next. He is a little fighter and has the technique to succeed in these conditions. Bangladesh need him to stabilize the innings along with the another senior partner, Tamim Iqbal.

OUT! Sabbir has thrown it away! Poor, very poor shot selection from him. Ran out of patience too soon, just the third ball he faced. Chase angles in a length ball around off, Rahman gives the charge with the intention to heave it over mid-wicket but it takes the top edge and goes straight up in the air towards third man. Tim Murtagh runs in and across a bit to his right and grabs a fantastic tumbling catch. Bangladesh struggling!
Back of a length ball on off, it's played from the crease to point.
Nice bowling. Keeps probing with a fuller length outside off, the angle takes it away from the southpaw, Tamim has another watchful leave.
An overpitched delivery this time, outside off, Iqbal drives it nicely off his front foot but finds the wide mid off fielder.
An inviting length outside off, Iqbal watches the line closely before leaving it. Good judgement.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Iqbal allows it through.

Nearly carries to the fielder! Once again Tamim commits himself on the front foot as he tries to flick a length delivery. But it flies off the inside edge and goes on one bounce to Dockrell at mid-wicket.
This one is angled away from the batsman, Tamim plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Movement in the air as it lands on a length around middle, Iqbal commits himself on the front foot and keeps it out off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.

Snorter! Welcome to the crease, Sabbir. Chase bends his back and bangs in a short ball around off, Rahman is taken by surprise as he tries to fend it away. Takes a blow on his helmet in the process but no harm done, fortunately. A nasty welcome to the new batsman.
Sabbir Rahman is the new batsman at number 3.

OUT! Sarkar 'Chased' out of the ground! Brilliant delivery, on back of a length around off and moving away a shade off the seam, Sarkar has a tame push inside the line without any footwork and gets a thin outside edge behind to the keeper. Niall O'Brien makes no mistake, they appeal and the finger goes up. Excellent start for Ireland.
A little bit of sawdust applied on the bowler's landing area.
Bouncer, nicely directed, Sarkar leans back and lets it through to the keeper.

FOUR! Misfield! Chase digs in a short ball around off, rising onto the batsman, Sarkar stands tall inside the crease and slams it square of the wicket. The point fielder dives to his right, gets some hands onto it but fails to stop it cleanly. It brushes past his fingers to the fence behind.
Shortish and on off, defended from the back foot to backward point.
Bouncer around off, angling away, Sarkar allows it through.
Peter Chase to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Another watchful leave outside the off stump by Tamim to end the over. A decent start by Tim!
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, inviting the batsman for a drive, but Iqbal is careful in leaving it.
Pitches it full and just outside off, Sarkar gets forward and bunts it to mid off for a quick single. Gets off the mark!
Back of a length ball on off, Sarkar goes on the back foot and plays it down in front of the cover fielder.

Angles it away from the batsman, on a length and outside off, Tamim leans forward, pushes inside the line and gets it away from the outside half of the bat. It speeds down to third man and they take a single.
Starts with a very full length ball on leg, it's flicked through square leg for a couple of runs. Bangladesh are away immediately.
It's time to get underway! Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar are the Bangladesh openers. Tim Murtagh to kickoff proceedings with the ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...
Update 1102 local - Through twitter we are getting the news that the rain has stopped and the covers are coming off. The game will start in 8 minutes. Stay tuned...

It appears there is a slight delay in start. There is a light drizzle at the moment and the umpires along with a few Irish players are waiting near the boundary line for it to ease off. The groundsmen are on the field and the pitch is covered. Stay tuned for latest updates...
Bangladesh - Tamim Iqbal, Soumya Sarkar, Sabbir Rahman, Shakib Al Hasan(c), Mosaddek Hossain, Mushfiqur Rahim(w), Mahmudullah, Mehedi Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Rubel Hossain, Mustafizur Rahman.
Ireland - Paul Stirling, William Porterfield(c), Niall O'Brien(w), Andrew Balbirnie, Stuart Thompson, Gary Wilson, Kevin O'Brien, George Dockrell, Barry McCarthy, Tim Murtagh, Peter Chase.

TOSS - Ireland win the toss and elect to field! We are hearing that it's a green pitch and hence it's a no-brainer from the Irish skipper William Porterfield. A big test awaits the Bangladesh batsmen.

Hello and welcome everyone for the first game of the tri-series between Ireland and Bangladesh in Dublin. The home team will be eager to present a tough fight in front of the Asian team and showcase their potential. The conditions will assist their style of play and Bangladesh would have to adapt. They are playing under overcast conditions and with the ball expected to move around, it will be a big challenge for them. Stay tuned for more updates...
